sitedescription: From Tier-1 Support to Enterprise Systems Architect — driven by C# tooling, PowerShell automation, and infrastructure optimization.

description.role: 2020 – 2022: SCCM Infrastructure Engineer L3 | SwiconGroup

Owned OS Deployment (OSD) and Windows In-Place Upgrade pipelines, engineering custom WinPE HTA tools for pre-PXE customization and architecting Zero-Touch Installations (ZTI). Handled physical datacenter rack installations while managing VMware Horizon VDI infrastructure—authoring optimized master images and maintaining storage redundancy across virtualized environments.

description.role: 2017 – 2020: System Administrator (SCCM) | evosoft (Siemens)

Modernized software packaging by introducing the PowerShell App Deployment Toolkit (PSADT) to standardize deployment workflows. Engineered a dynamic AD-group-driven automation framework to trigger targeted logon/startup scripts globally, integrating automated completion-time logging to drive domain-wide performance optimization.

description.role: 2017: Software Distribution Engineer L2 | DXC Technology
description.desc: Engineered custom object-oriented VB.NET GUI tools to automate remote Active Directory management and bulk-endpoint remediation for enterprise clients like SKF, drastically cutting resolution times. description.role: 2012 – 2017: ITO Service Delivery Consultant II | Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE)

Optimized logon/startup scripts using VBScript and Batch to significantly reduce boot times and implemented standardized endpoint logging. Modernized GPO architecture using Loopback Processing (LSAD) and GPO Preferences, establishing dedicated test OU structures to ensure targeted policy enforcement.

description.role: 2010 – 2012: Senior Level 2 Service Desk Agent | HP
description.desc: Elevated to Senior L2 Technical Lead at HP, steering support operations for Monier and Panasonic. Specialized in deciphering systemic infrastructure issues from minimal diagnostics, handling complex escalations, and mentoring cross-functional team members.

description.role: 2008 – 2010: Service Desk Analyst & Shared Desk | Getronics / IT Services Hungary

Applied multilingual fluency (German, English, Dutch) and intuitive root-cause analysis to resolve complex technical issues across global environments.

description.role: Modular Master Controller

description.role: Performance Monitoring & Optimization
description.desc: Integrated a centralized execution log that calculates individual script runtimes and outputs total elapsed time per session to benchmark and optimize overall user logon duration.

dropdownItems.title: SCCM & Matrix42 Infrastructure Health Tester
dropdownItems.description: An automated PowerShell diagnostic tool scheduled for daily morning execution to evaluate core endpoint infrastructure health. It performs automated WMI connectivity verification between managed servers and the SCCM environment, while simultaneously scanning Matrix42 Enterprise Manager event logs for operational errors. Upon detecting system anomalies, the framework automatically triggers alerts to the central enterprise monitoring platform and initiates automated IT Service Management ticket creation for immediate engineering remediation.

dropdownItems.title: PC Information Tool (v1.01)
dropdownItems.description:
Distributed to enterprise endpoint devices to empower end-users with instant self-service system visibility. Aggregates critical General, Hardware, and Network parameters (IP, MAC, Serial, OS version) into a clear interface.

Features a prominent 'Copy Information to clipboard' action to eliminate ticket back-and-forth by letting users instantly paste diagnostics into support requests. Includes built-in Quick-Fix, Software inventory, and Diagnostic tabs for automated issue remediation.

Documentation: https://peskyjim.blogspot.com/p/pc-info-tool.html

dropdownItems.title: Ultimate Active Directory Search Tool (UADST)
dropdownItems.description:
Streamlined administrative utility designed as a lightweight alternative to native Active Directory Users and Computers (ADUC). Enables rapid object discovery across Users, Computers, and Groups within the domain.

Features customizable 'Column Select' controls to extract only relevant AD attributes (e.g., operatingSystem, lastLogonTimestamp), secondary filtering options, and group membership lookups. Includes one-click output export and clipboard copying complete with headers for easy documentation.

Documentation: https://peskyjim.blogspot.com/p/ad-query-tool.html

dropdownItems.title: IT - Ping & Remote Action Tool
dropdownItems.description:
Multi-threaded reachability and remote administration utility for helpdesk and sysadmins. Allows bulk monitoring of computer lists, resolving real-time IP addresses, Online/Offline status, and FQDNs.

Selecting any target host automatically populates the quick-action panel to execute instant remote administration tasks: pull detailed system info via WMI ('Get Info'), open the administrative share ('Open C$'), or spawn a remote PowerShell session ('PSSession').

Documentation: https://peskyjim.blogspot.com/p/ping-tool.html

dropdownItems.title: Active Directory Security Group Updater
dropdownItems.description:
Bulk administration utility built to perform safe, high-speed Active Directory security group membership updates. Enables administrators to add or remove multiple target user/computer objects across multiple groups simultaneously in a single execution pass.

Includes a dedicated real-time Error Handling & Reporting Grid that tracks individual operation statuses (e.g., User Added, User Not Found, Already a Member). Provides immediate visual confirmation and instant audit feedback for ticket documentation.

Documentation: https://peskyjim.blogspot.com/p/ad-security-group-updater.html
